description_en: Adds transcoding configurations. You can create a transcoding template group or add transcoding templates to a specified template group
description_zh: 调用本接口添加转码配置信息，可创建新的转码模板组，或者向指定模板组中添加新的转码模板
kebab_example: aliyun vod add-transcode-template-group --name transcodetemplate --transcode-template-list Video_:_Bitrate_:_400_,_Codec_:_H.264_,_Fps_:_30_,_Height_:360,_Width_:640_,_Definition_:_SD_,_Container_:_Format_:_mp4_,_TemplateName_:_testName_,_MuxConfig_:_,_Audio_:_Codec_:_AAC_,_Bitrate_:_64_,_Samplerate_:_44100 --transcode-template-group-id 4c71a339fe52b4fa6f45270000 --app-id app-0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddTranscodeTemplateGroup

parameters.help_en:
The name of the transcoding template group.

The name can be up to 128 bytes in length.
The value is encoded in UTF-8.
You must specify either TranscodeTemplateGroupId or Name
parameters.help_zh:
转码模板组名称。

长度不超过128个字节。
UTF-8编码。
TranscodeTemplateGroupId和Name必须传递一个
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The transcoding template configurations in the JSON format. For more information about the parameter structure, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52839.html.
If you do not specify this parameter, the transcoding process is not created and video uploads do not trigger transcoding.
If you do not need to set the Width or Height property, do not specify the corresponding property. Do not set it to an empty string, such as "Height":""
parameters.help_zh:
转码模板配置信息（JSON字符串）。参数结构详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52839.html。
该参数不传递，则不会构建转码处理流程，视频上传不会触发转码。
如果不需要设置Width或者Height属性，则不传相应属性即可，请不要设置为空串，例如："Height":""
parameters.name: transcode_template_list

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the transcoding template group. If you specify the ID of a transcoding template group, new transcoding templates are added to the specified template group.
You must specify either TranscodeTemplateGroupId or Name
parameters.help_zh:
转码模板组ID。若指定了转码模板组ID，则可向指定的模板组中添加新的转码模板。
TranscodeTemplateGroupId和Name必须传递一个
parameters.name: transcode_template_group_id

parameters.help_en: The application ID. Default value: app-1000000. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/113600.html
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID。默认取值： app-1000000。使用说明，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/113600.html
parameters.name: app_id

TranscodeTemplateGroupId.description_en: The ID of the transcoding template group
